lines: Two men climbed the wall into a king's prayer room. What did they want?
They said: Fear not. Two adversaries, one has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth.
This, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe. And he said: give her to me.
Prophet Dawud, alayhis salaam, became certain it was a test. He asked forgiveness of his Lord, and fell down bowing.
A prophet and a king turned back to Allah in a moment. Turn back today.
